name: @idni/tau-lang-js-test-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling: the headless-Chrome wasm test harness (bindings/js/tests) and the terminal UI the browser REPL (js/repl) copies into its build output at configure time. Not the published package -- that manifest is bindings/js/package.json.in, configure_file'd into the build directory, which *is* the installable package.
